note.zh-TW: 網站補充的延伸科目，術語表沒有獨立的條目；模板沒有這一列。
note.en: An extension account added by the site; the glossary has no separate entry and the template has no such line.

definition.zh-TW: 股東會決議要發、但還沒付給股東的股利。它和借款一樣不能放進間接法的其他負債增加列，付款時走籌資活動。
definition.en: Dividends declared but not yet paid to shareholders. Like borrowings it must be excluded from the increase in other liabilities line of the indirect method; the payment is a financing cash flow.
